purpose: Commit and push existing code, configuration, research documents and summarized results at user request.
user_storage_choice: Code, documents and summarized results; retain large data and previously distribution-pending thesis/literature locally.
selection_policy: Preserve original tracked edits to .gitignore and README.md unchanged; do not rewrite research conditions, algorithms, inputs, existing results or evidence.
Include new code, configurations, tests, reviewed frozen-demand v1 inputs, research protocols and audit records.
Retain files in the prior PENDING_DECISIONS.csv, external source/full-text or page-render evidence, conversation export, symbolic links and artifacts over 10 MiB locally.

Include poster/slide assets and ToC run-root summaries; nested ToC summaries are limited to depth six, selected by summary/report/validation/registration/manifest/result/adoption naming or figure/plot/table directories.
Retain test products, detailed per-run data, roads/inputs/matrices, runtime branches/trials, and source snapshots in ToC output locally.
No new ignore rules hide excluded files; excluded files remain visible and in place. The gzip inventory is metadata, not a backup.

validation.regression_command: PYTHONPATH=src PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .conda/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/toc_dwt/test_cpu_parallel.py tests/toc_comparison_v1/test_contract_and_evaluation.py tests/toc_common/test_common.py
validation.credential_scan_limits: Known high-confidence private-key and token patterns in text-like files; not a guarantee that every possible secret is absent.
validation.scope: Small regression and syntax checks only. No full experiment, demand generation, frozen-input edits or historical result regeneration.

push_status_at_record_creation: Pending commit and normal fast-forward push; verify remote SHA after push.
